mapper.sql: SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, p.project_code, p.manager_ids, p.manager_names, p.dept_id, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.status, p.description, p.contract_type, p.contract_id, p.contract_no, p.contract_name, p.partner_name, p.sale_contract_id, p.sale_contract_no, p.sale_contract_name, p.sale_partner_name, p.purchase_contract_id, p.purchase_contract_no, p.purchase_contract_name, p.purchase_partner_name, p.repair_contract_id, p.repair_contract_no, p.repair_contract_name, p.repair_partner_name, p.other_file_ids, p.del_flag, p.tenant_id, p.create_user, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, d.name AS dept_name FROM sign_project p LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON p.dept_id = d.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sign_project ( project_name, project_code, manager_ids, manager_names, dept_id, start_date, end_date, status, description, contract_type, contract_id, contract_no, contract_name, partner_name, sale_contract_id, sale_contract_no, sale_contract_name, sale_partner_name, purchase_contract_id, purchase_contract_no, purchase_contract_name, purchase_partner_name, repair_contract_id, repair_contract_no, repair_contract_name, repair_partner_name, other_file_ids, del_flag, tenant_id, create_user, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{projectName}, #{projectCode}, #{managerIds}, #{managerNames}, #{deptId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{description}, #{contractType}, #{contractId}, #{contractNo}, #{contractName}, #{partnerName}, #{saleContractId}, #{saleContractNo}, #{saleContractName}, #{salePartnerName}, #{purchaseContractId}, #{purchaseContractNo}, #{purchaseContractName}, #{purchasePartnerName}, #{repairContractId}, #{repairContractNo}, #{repairContractName}, #{repairPartnerName}, #{otherFileIds}, '0', #{tenantId}, #{createUser}, #{createBy}, #{createTime} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE sign_project SET del_flag = '2' WHERE project_id IN
#{projectId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sign_project_seal (project_id, seal_id, create_by, create_time) VALUES
(#{projectId}, #{sealId}, '', NOW())

INSERT INTO sign_project_user (project_id, user_id, create_time) VALUES
(#{projectId}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sign_project SET status = CASE WHEN status IN ('1', '2') AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date <= NOW() THEN '3' WHEN status = '1' AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND start_date <= NOW() THEN '2' ELSE status END, update_time = NOW() WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('1', '2') AND ( (status = '1' AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND start_date <= NOW()) OR (status IN ('1', '2') AND end_date IS NOT NULL AND end_date <= NOW()) )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM sign_project p LEFT JOIN sign_project_user pu ON p.project_id = pu.project_id WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status = '2' AND (FIND_IN_SET(#{userId}, p.manager_ids) OR pu.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT seal_id FROM sign_project_seal WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY seal_id ASC
SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(project_code, #{substringPos}) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM sign_project WHERE del_flag = '0' AND project_code LIKE #{likePattern}

choose.when: SELECT 'SALE' AS contractType, c.id, c.contract_no AS contractNo, c.contract_name AS contractName, u.unit_name AS partnerName, c.file_id AS fileId FROM psi_contract_sale c LEFT JOIN psi_unit u ON u.id = c.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.id = #{contractId} LIMIT 1

SELECT 'PURCHASE' AS contractType, c.id, c.contract_no AS contractNo, c.contract_name AS contractName, u.unit_name AS partnerName, c.file_id AS fileId FROM psi_contract_purchase c LEFT JOIN psi_unit u ON u.id = c.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.id = #{contractId} LIMIT 1

SELECT 'REPAIR' AS contractType, c.id, c.contract_no AS contractNo, c.contract_name AS contractName, cust.unit_name AS partnerName, c.file_id AS fileId FROM eoms_contract c LEFT JOIN psi_unit cust ON cust.id = c.customer_id AND cust.deleted = 0 WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.id = #{contractId} LIMIT 1
